name: Ethan Michael Harper
title: Junior iOS Developer
summary: Junior iOS Developer with hands-on experience building and maintaining Swift-based mobile features for consumer apps. Strong foundation in UIKit, SwiftUI, and REST API integration, with a focus on clean code, responsive UI, and collaboration with product and design teams.

bullets: Built and shipped 8+ SwiftUI screens for a consumer finance app, contributing to a 15% increase in weekly active users over 6 months.
Integrated REST APIs for login, account summary, and transaction history, reducing manual data refreshes by 40%.
Worked with designers and QA to resolve 60+ UI and device-specific issues before release.
Improved app startup performance by 18% by reducing unnecessary view rendering and optimizing image loading.
Implemented reusable UIKit components for onboarding and profile flows, cutting duplicate UI code by 25%.
Assisted in debugging crashes using Xcode and Firebase Crashlytics, helping reduce crash rate by 12%.
Updated network request handling and error states across 3 app modules to improve reliability.
Participated in weekly sprint planning, code reviews, and release testing for biweekly builds.
Supported development of an internal iOS utility app used by 200+ employees for scheduling and notifications.
Created and maintained unit tests for view models and service layers, increasing coverage from 28% to 41%.
Documented feature behavior and setup steps, reducing onboarding time for new interns and contractors.
Collaborated with backend engineers to validate JSON payloads and fix 10+ integration issues.
Assisted in building mobile-friendly features for a public service portal using Swift and UIKit.
Worked on accessibility improvements including Dynamic Type and VoiceOver support for key screens.
Helped triage and reproduce bugs across 2 release cycles, improving turnaround time for fixes.
Contributed to internal Git workflows and pull request reviews in a small cross-functional team.
